name: mem_stabilizer
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_stabilizer {ρ : Representation k G V} {v : V} {g : G} :
    g ∈ stabilizer ρ v ↔ ρ g v = v

name: stabilizer_zero
statement: lemma stabilizer_zero (ρ : Representation k G V) : stabilizer ρ 0 = ⊤

name: le_stabilizer_smul
statement:
lemma le_stabilizer_smul (ρ : Representation k G V) (c : k) (v : V) :
    stabilizer ρ v ≤ stabilizer ρ (c • v)

name: le_stabilizer_add
statement:
lemma le_stabilizer_add (ρ : Representation k G V) (v1 v2 : V) :
    (stabilizer ρ v1) ⊓ (stabilizer ρ v2) ≤ stabilizer ρ (v1 + v2)

name: le_stabilizer_sum
statement:
lemma le_stabilizer_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ρ : Representation k G V) (v : ι → V) :
    ⨅ i, (stabilizer ρ (v i)) ≤ stabilizer ρ (∑ i, v i)

name: IntertwiningMap.stabilizer_le
statement:
lemma IntertwiningMap.stabilizer_le {ρ : Representation k G V} {ρ' : Representation k G V'}
    (f : ρ.IntertwiningMap ρ') (v : V) : stabilizer ρ v ≤ stabilizer ρ' (f v)

name: stabilizer_conj
statement:
lemma stabilizer_conj (ρ : Representation k G V) (g : G) (v : V) :
    ρ.stabilizer (ρ g v) = (stabilizer ρ v).map (MulAut.conj g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_stabilizer, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, MulAut.conj_apply,
    ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← inv_apply_eq_iff, ← map_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩, by rintro ⟨y, hy1, rfl⟩; simp [mul_assoc, hy1]⟩

name: conjugate_apply
statement:
theorem conjugate_apply (g : G) (v : W) :
    π.conjugate g v = MonoidAlgebra.single g⁻¹ (1 : k) • π (MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k) • v)

name: conjugate_i
statement:
theorem conjugate_i (h : ∀ v : V, π (i v) = v) (g : G) (v : V) :
    (conjugate π g : W → V) (i v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_apply, ← i.map_smul, h, ← mul_smul, single_mul_single, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel,
    ← one_def, one_smul]

name: sumOfConjugates_apply
statement: lemma sumOfConjugates_apply (v : W) : π.sumOfConjugates G v = ∑ g : G, π.conjugate g v

name: sumOfConjugatesEquivariant_apply
statement:
theorem sumOfConjugatesEquivariant_apply (v : W) :
    π.sumOfConjugatesEquivariant G v = ∑ g : G, π.conjugate g v

name: equivariantProjection_apply
statement:
theorem equivariantProjection_apply (v : W) :
    π.equivariantProjection G v = (Nat.card G : k)⁻¹ʳ • ∑ g : G, π.conjugate g v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equivariantProjection, smul_apply, sumOfConjugatesEquivariant_apply,
    Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]

name: equivariantProjection_condition
statement:
theorem equivariantProjection_condition (hcard : IsUnit (Nat.card G : k))
    (h : ∀ v : V, π (i v) = v) (v : V) : (π.equivariantProjection G) (i v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivariantProjection_apply]
  simp only [conjugate_i π i h]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k, smul_smul,
    Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hcard, one_smul]

name: exists_leftInverse_of_injective
statement:
theorem exists_leftInverse_of_injective (f : V →ₗ[k[G]] W) (hf : LinearMap.ker f = ⊥) :
    ∃ g : W →ₗ[k[G]] V, g.comp f = .id
proof:
:= by
  let A := k[G]
  let : Module k W := .compHom W (algebraMap k A)
  let : Module k V := .compHom V (algebraMap k A)
  have := IsScalarTower.of_compHom k A W
  have := IsScalarTower.of_compHom k A V
  set φ := (f.restrictScalars k).leftInverse
  have hφ : ∀ (x : V), φ (f x) = x := by
    apply LinearMap.leftInverse_apply_of_inj
    simp [hf]
  have _ : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  refine ⟨φ.equivariantProjection G, LinearMap.ext ?_⟩
  exact φ.equivariantProjection_condition G _ (.mk0 _ <| NeZero.ne _) <| hφ

name: exists_isCompl
statement: theorem exists_isCompl (p : Submodule k[G] V) : ∃ q : Submodule k[G] V, IsCompl p q
proof:
:= by
  rcases MonoidAlgebra.exists_leftInverse_of_injective p.subtype p.ker_subtype with ⟨f, hf⟩
  exact ⟨LinearMap.ker f, LinearMap.isCompl_of_proj <| DFunLike.congr_fun hf⟩

name: Iso.conj_

    W.ρ g = (FDRep.isoToLinearEquiv i).conj (V.ρ g)
proof:

  rw [FDRep.isoToLinearEquiv, ← hom_hom_action_ρ V, ← FGModuleCat.Iso.conj_hom_eq_conj,
    Iso.conj_apply, ← ModuleCat.hom_ofHom (W.ρ g), ← ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff]
  dsimp only [Action.forget_map, Functor.mapIso_hom]

proof:

  Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨⟨s, x⟩, hs⟩ => by
    simpa [← hs] using mem_ker_of_eq
      ⟨g * s * g⁻¹, Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem ‹_› s.1 s.2 g⟩ (ρ g x) _ <| by simp

    fun x hx => ⟨(⟨x, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 hx⟩ : Representation.Coinvariants.ker <|
      A.ρ.comp S.subtype), rfl⟩
  mono_f := (Rep.mono_iff_injective _).2 fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext h
  epi_g := (Rep.epi_iff_surjective _).2 <| Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: equivHom_injective
statement: lemma equivHom_injective [Nontrivial k] : Function.Injective (equivHom k G)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  classical
  apply_fun (fun x ↦ (x.hom.hom.app rightFDRep).hom (single t 1) 1) at h
  simp_all [single_apply]

name: map_mul_toRightFDRepComp
statement:
lemma map_mul_toRightFDRepComp (η : Aut (forget k G)) (f g : G → k) :
    let α : (G → k) →ₗ[k] (G → k)
proof:
:= (η.hom.hom.app rightFDRep).hom.hom
    α (f * g) = (α f) * (α g) := by
  have nat := η.hom.hom.naturality mulRepHom
  have tensor (X Y) : η.hom.hom.app (X ⊗ Y) = (η.hom.hom.app X ⊗ₘ η.hom.hom.app Y) :=
    η.hom.isMonoidal.tensor X Y
  rw [tensor] at nat
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((CategoryTheory.forget _).congr_map nat) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g)

name: sumSMulInv_single_id
statement:
lemma sumSMulInv_single_id [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] {X : FDRep k G} (v : X) :
    ∑ s : G, (single 1 1 : G → k) s • (X.ρ s⁻¹) v = v

name: toRightFDRepComp_injective
statement:
lemma toRightFDRepComp_injective {η₁ η₂ : Aut (forget k G)}
    (h : η₁.hom.hom.app rightFDRep = η₂.hom.hom.app rightFDRep) : η₁ = η₂
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  classical
  ext X v
  have h1 := η₁.hom.hom.naturality (ofRightFDRep X v)
  have h2 := η₂.hom.hom.naturality (ofRightFDRep X v)
  rw [h, ← h2] at h1
  simpa using congr(($h1).hom (single 1 1))

name: toRightFDRepComp_in_rightRegular
statement:
lemma toRightFDRepComp_in_rightRegular [IsDomain k] (η : Aut (forget k G)) :
    ∃ (s : G), (η.hom.hom.app rightFDRep).hom.hom = rightRegular s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ((evalAlgHom _ _ 1).comp (algHomOfRightFDRepComp η)).eq_piEvalAlgHom
  refine ⟨s, (basisFun k G).ext fun u ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [rightFDRep, forget_obj]
  ext t
  have nat := η.hom.hom.naturality (leftRegularFDRepHom t⁻¹)
  calc
    _ = leftRegular t⁻¹ ((η.hom.hom.app rightFDRep).hom (single u 1)) 1 := by simp
    _ = (η.hom.hom.app rightFDRep).hom (leftRegular t⁻¹ (single u 1)) 1 :=
      congrFun congr(($nat.symm).hom (single u 1)) 1
    _ = evalAlgHom _ _ s (leftRegular t⁻¹ (single u 1)) :=
      congr($hs (leftRegular t⁻¹ (single u 1)))
    _ = _ := by by_cases u = t * s <;> simp_all

name: equivHom_surjective
statement: lemma equivHom_surjective [IsDomain k] : Function.Surjective (equivHom k G)
proof:
:= by
  intro η
  obtain ⟨s, h⟩ := toRightFDRepComp_in_rightRegular η
  exact ⟨s, toRightFDRepComp_injective (InducedCategory.hom_ext (hom_ext h.symm))⟩

name: asModuleEquiv_symm_map_rho
statement:
@[simp]
theorem asModuleEquiv_symm_map_rho (g : G) (x : V) :
    ρ.asModuleEquiv.symm (ρ g x) = MonoidAlgebra.of k G g • ρ.asModuleEquiv.symm x

name: ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply (r : k[G])
    (m : RestrictScalars k k[G] M) :
    ((ofModule M).asAlgebraHom r) m =
      (RestrictScalars.addEquiv _ _ _).symm (r • RestrictScalars.addEquiv _ _ _ m)
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidAlgebra.induction_on r
  · intro g
    simp only [one_smul, MonoidAlgebra.lift_symm_apply, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply,
      Representation.asAlgebraHom_single, Representation.ofModule,
      RestrictScalars.lsmul_apply_apply]
  · intro f g fw gw
    simp only [fw, gw, map_add, add_smul, LinearMap.add_apply]
  · intro r f w
    simp only [w, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, RestrictScalars.addEquiv_symm_map_smul_smul]

name: ofModule_asModule_act
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofModule_asModule_act (g : G) (x : RestrictScalars k k[G] ρ.asModule) :
    ofModule ρ.asModule g x =
      (RestrictScalars.addEquiv _ _ _).symm
        (ρ.asModuleEquiv.symm (ρ g (ρ.asModuleEquiv (RestrictScalars.addEquiv _ _ _ x))))

name: smul_ofModule_asModule
statement:
theorem smul_ofModule_asModule (r : k[G]) (m : (ofModule M).asModule) :
    (RestrictScalars.addEquiv k _ _) ((ofModule M).asModuleEquiv (r • m)) =
      r • (RestrictScalars.addEquiv k _ _) ((ofModule M).asModuleEquiv (G := G) m)

name: single_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma single_smul (t : k) (g : G) (v : ρ.asModule) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single (g : G) t • v = t • ρ g (ρ.asModuleEquiv v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.smul_apply, ← asAlgebraHom_single, ← asModuleEquiv_map_smul]
  rfl

name: norm_comp_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_comp_self (g : G) : norm ρ ∘ₗ ρ g = norm ρ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa [norm] using Fintype.sum_bijective (· * g) (Group.mulRight_bijective g) _ _ <| by simp

name: norm_self_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_self_apply (g : G) (x : V) : norm ρ (ρ g x) = norm ρ x

name: self_comp_norm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma self_comp_norm (g : G) : ρ g ∘ₗ norm ρ = norm ρ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa [norm] using Fintype.sum_bijective (g * ·) (Group.mulLeft_bijective g) _ _ <| by simp

name: self_norm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma self_norm_apply (g : G) (x : V) : ρ g (norm ρ x) = norm ρ x

name: apply_eq_of_coe_eq
statement:
lemma apply_eq_of_coe_eq [IsTrivial (ρ.comp S.subtype)] (g h : G) (hgh : (g : G ⧸ S) = h) :
    ρ g = ρ h
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine (apply_bijective ρ g⁻¹).injective.eq_iff.1 ?_
  simpa using (isTrivial_apply (ρ.comp S.subtype) ⟨g⁻¹ * h, QuotientGroup.eq.1 hgh⟩ x).symm

name: ofQuotient_coe_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofQuotient_coe_apply [IsTrivial (ρ.comp S.subtype)] (g : G) (x : V) :
    ofQuotient ρ S (g : G ⧸ S) x = ρ g x

name: apply_sub_id_partialSum_eq
statement:
lemma apply_sub_id_partialSum_eq (n : ℕ) (g : G) (x : V) :
    (ρ g - LinearMap.id (R := k) (M := V)) ((Fin.last _).partialSum
      (fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) => ρ (g ^ (j : ℕ)) x)) = ρ (g ^ (n + 1)) x - x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Fin.partialSum]
  | succ n h =>
    have : Fin.init (fun (j : Fin (n + 2)) => ρ (g ^ (j : ℕ)) x) =
      fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) => ρ (g ^ (j : ℕ)) x := by ext; simp [Fin.init]
    rw [← Fin.succ_eq_last_succ.2 rfl, Fin.partialSum_succ, ← Fin.partialSum_init, map_add,
      this, h]
    simp [pow_succ']

name: ofMulAction_def
statement:
theorem ofMulAction_def (g : G) :
    ofMulAction k G H g = (coeffLinearEquiv k).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Finsupp.lmapDomain k k (g • ·) ∘ₗ
      (coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap

name: ofMulAction_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofMulAction_single (g : G) (x : H) (r : k) :
    ofMulAction k G H g (single x r) = single (g • x) r

name: ofDistribMulAction_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDistribMulAction_apply_apply (g : G) (a : A) :
    ofDistribMulAction k G A g a = g • a

name: norm_ofDistribMulAction_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_ofDistribMulAction_eq {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    [DistribMulAction G A] [SMulCommClass G k A] (x : A) :
    (ofDistribMulAction k G A).norm x = ∑ g : G, g • x

name: ofMulDistribMulAction_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofMulDistribMulAction_apply_apply (g : M) (a : Additive G) :
    ofMulDistribMulAction M G g a = Additive.ofMul (g • a.toMul)

name: norm_ofMulDistribMulAction_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_ofMulDistribMulAction_eq {G M : Type} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    [CommGroup M] [MulDistribMulAction G M] (x : Additive M) :
    Additive.toMul ((ofMulDistribMulAction G M).norm x) =
      ∏ g : G, g • Additive.toMul x

name: coeff_ofMulAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_ofMulAction {H : Type*} [MulAction G H] (g : G) (f : k[H]) (h : H) :
    (ofMulAction k G H g f).coeff h = f.coeff (g⁻¹ • h)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← smul_inv_smul g h]
  set h' := g⁻¹ • h
  have hg : Function.Injective (g • · : H → H) := by
    intro h₁ h₂
    simp
  simp [ofMulAction_def, hg]

name: asAlgebraHom_ofMulAction_smul_eq_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma asAlgebraHom_ofMulAction_smul_eq_mul (x y : k[G]) :
    (ofMulAction k G G).asAlgebraHom x y = x * y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | of g => ext; simp [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy, add_mul]
  | smul r x hx => simp [← hx]

name: asGroupHom_apply
statement: theorem asGroupHom_apply (g : G) : ↑(asGroupHom ρ g) = ρ g

name: leftRegular_norm_apply
statement:
lemma leftRegular_norm_apply :
    (leftRegular k G).norm =
      (LinearMap.lsmul k _).flip ((leftRegular k G).norm (single 1 1)) ∘ₗ
      linearCombination _ (fun _ => 1) ∘ₗ (coeffLinearEquiv _).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 2
  simpa [Representation.norm] using Finset.sum_bijective _
    (Group.mulRight_bijective i) (by simp) (by simp)

name: leftRegular_norm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma leftRegular_norm_eq_zero_iff (x : k[G]) :
    (leftRegular k G).norm x = 0 ↔ x.coeff.linearCombination k (fun _ => (1 : k)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftRegular_norm_apply]
  constructor
  · rw [MonoidAlgebra.ext_iff, Finsupp.ext_iff]
    intro h
    simpa [norm, Representation.norm] using h 1
  · intro h
    ext
    simp_all

name: ker_leftRegular_norm_eq
statement:
lemma ker_leftRegular_norm_eq :
    LinearMap.ker (leftRegular k G).norm = LinearMap.ker
      (linearCombination k (fun _ => (1 : k)) ∘ₗ (coeffLinearEquiv _).toLinearMap)

name: coeff_of_leftRegular_of_generator
statement:
lemma coeff_of_leftRegular_of_generator (g : G) (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    (x : k[G]) (hx : leftRegular k G g x = x) (γ : G) :
    x.coeff γ = x.coeff g
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.ext_iff, Finsupp.ext_iff] at hx
  rcases hg γ with ⟨i, rfl⟩
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa using hx g
  | succ n h =>
    simpa [← h, zpow_natCast, zpow_add_one, pow_mul_comm', pow_succ'] using (hx (g ^ (n + 1))).symm
  | pred n h =>
    simpa [zpow_sub, ← h, ← mul_inv_rev, ← pow_mul_comm'] using hx (g ^ (-n : ℤ))

name: tprod_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tprod_apply (g : G) : (ρV ⊗ ρW) g = TensorProduct.map (ρV g) (ρW g)

name: smul_tprod_one_asModule
statement:
theorem smul_tprod_one_asModule (r : k[G]) (x : V) (y : W) :
    r • (show (ρV.tprod 1).asModule from x ⊗ₜ y) = (r • show ρV.asModule from x) ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  change asAlgebraHom (ρV ⊗ 1) _ _ = asAlgebraHom ρV _ _ ⊗ₜ _
  simp only [asAlgebraHom_def, MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply, tprod_apply, MonoidHom.one_apply,
    LinearMap.finsupp_sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Module.End.one_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
  rfl

name: smul_one_tprod_asModule
statement:
theorem smul_one_tprod_asModule (r : k[G]) (x : V) (y : W) :
    r • (show (1 ⊗ ρW).asModule from x ⊗ₜ y) = x ⊗ₜ (r • show ρW.asModule from y)
proof:
:= by
  change asAlgebraHom (1 ⊗ ρW) _ _ = _ ⊗ₜ asAlgebraHom ρW _ _
  simp only [asAlgebraHom_def, MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply, tprod_apply, MonoidHom.one_apply,
    LinearMap.finsupp_sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Module.End.one_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, TensorProduct.tmul_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: linHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linHom_apply (g : G) (f : V →ₗ[k] W) : (linHom ρV ρW) g f = ρW g ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ ρV g⁻¹

name: dual_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dual_apply (g : G) : (dual ρV) g = Module.Dual.transpose (R := k) (ρV g⁻¹)

name: dualTensorHom_comm
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_comm (g : G) :
    dualTensorHom k V W ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (ρV.dual g) (ρW g) =
      (linHom ρV ρW) g ∘ₗ dualTensorHom k V W

name: finsupp_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsupp_single (g : G) (x : α) (a : A) :
    ρ.finsupp α g (single x a) = single x (ρ g a)

name: free_single_single
statement:
lemma free_single_single (g h : G) (i : α) (r : k) :
    free k G α g (single i (single h r)) = .single i (single (g * h) r)

name: free_asModule_free
statement: theorem free_asModule_free : Module.Free k[G] (free k G α).asModule

name: indToCoindAux_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indToCoindAux_self (g : G) (a : A) :
    indToCoindAux A g a g = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [indToCoindAux, LinearMap.pi_apply, dite_eq_left]
  · simp [← S.1.one_def]
  · rfl

name: indToCoindAux_of_not_rel
statement:
lemma indToCoindAux_of_not_rel (g g₁ : G) (a : A) (h : ¬(QuotientGroup.rightRel S).r g₁ g) :
    indToCoindAux A g a g₁ = 0

name: indToCoindAux_mul_snd
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indToCoindAux_mul_snd (g g₁ : G) (a : A) (s : S) :
    indToCoindAux A g a (s * g₁) = A.ρ s (indToCoindAux A g a g₁)
proof:
:= by
  rcases em ((QuotientGroup.rightRel S).r g₁ g) with ⟨s₁, rfl⟩ | h
  · simp only [indToCoindAux, LinearMap.pi_apply]
    rw [dite_eq_left ⟨s * s₁, mul_assoc ..⟩, dite_eq_left ⟨s₁, rfl⟩]
    simp [S.1.smul_def, mul_assoc, ← S.1.mul_def]
  · rw [indToCoindAux_of_not_rel _ _ _ h, indToCoindAux_of_not_rel, map_zero]
    exact mt (fun ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ => ⟨s⁻¹ * s₁, by simp_all [S.1.smul_def, mul_assoc]⟩) h

name: indToCoindAux_mul_fst
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indToCoindAux_mul_fst (g₁ g₂ : G) (a : A) (s : S) :
     indToCoindAux A (s * g₁) (A.ρ s a) g₂ = indToCoindAux A g₁ a g₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases em ((QuotientGroup.rightRel S).r g₂ g₁) with ⟨s₁, rfl⟩ | h
  · simp only [indToCoindAux, LinearMap.pi_apply]
    rw [dite_eq_left ⟨s₁ * s⁻¹, by simp [S.1.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]⟩,
      dite_eq_left ⟨s₁, rfl⟩, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul]
    congr
    simp [Subtype.ext_iff, S.1.smul_def, mul_assoc]
  · rw [indToCoindAux_of_not_rel (h := h), indToCoindAux_of_not_rel]
    exact mt (fun ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ => ⟨s₁ * s, by simp_all [S.1.smul_def, mul_assoc]⟩) h

name: indToCoindAux_snd_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indToCoindAux_snd_mul_inv (g₁ g₂ g₃ : G) (a : A) :
    indToCoindAux A g₁ a (g₂ * g₃⁻¹) = indToCoindAux A (g₁ * g₃) a g₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases em ((QuotientGroup.rightRel S).r (g₂ * g₃⁻¹) g₁) with ⟨s, hs⟩ | h
  · simp [S.1.smul_def, mul_assoc, ← eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.1 hs]
  · rw [indToCoindAux_of_not_rel (h := h), indToCoindAux_of_not_rel]
    exact mt (fun ⟨s, hs⟩ => ⟨s, by simpa [S.1.smul_def, eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq, mul_assoc]⟩) h

name: indToCoindAux_fst_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indToCoindAux_fst_mul_inv (g₁ g₂ g₃ : G) (a : A) :
    indToCoindAux A (g₁ * g₂⁻¹) a g₃ = indToCoindAux A g₁ a (g₃ * g₂)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (indToCoindAux_snd_mul_inv g₁ g₃ g₂⁻¹ a).symm

name: indToCoindAux_comm
statement:
lemma indToCoindAux_comm {A B : Rep k S} (f : A ⟶ B) (g₁ g₂ : G) (a : A) :
    indToCoindAux B g₁ (f.hom a) g₂ = f.hom (indToCoindAux A g₁ a g₂)
proof:
:= by
  rcases em ((QuotientGroup.rightRel S).r g₂ g₁) with ⟨s, rfl⟩ | h
  · simp [S.1.smul_def, hom_comm_apply]
  · simp [indToCoindAux_of_not_rel (h := h)]

name: coindToInd_of_support_subset_orbit
statement:
lemma coindToInd_of_support_subset_orbit (g : G) (f : coind S.subtype A)
    (hx : f.1.support ⊆ MulAction.orbit S g) :
    coindToInd A f = IndV.mk S.subtype _ g (f.1 g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coindToInd_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟦g⟧]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | h b =>
    have : f.1 b = 0 := by
      simp_all only [Function.support_subset_iff, ne_eq, Quotient.eq]
      contrapose! hx
      use b, hx, hb
    simp_all
  · simp

name: coindToInd_indToCoind
statement: lemma coindToInd_indToCoind : A.indToCoind ∘ₗ A.coindToInd = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext g a
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]
  conv_lhs => rw [coindToInd_apply]
  simp only [map_sum, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟦a⟧]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | h b =>
    simpa using indToCoindAux_of_not_rel b a (g.1 b) (mt Quotient.sound hb.symm)
  · simp

name: indToCoind_coindToInd
statement: lemma indToCoind_coindToInd : A.coindToInd ∘ₗ A.indToCoind = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext g a
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply,
    TensorProduct.curry_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, LinearMap.id_apply]
  rw [coindToInd_of_support_subset_orbit g]
  · simp
  · intro x hx
    contrapose hx
    simpa using indToCoindAux_of_not_rel g x a hx

name: instIsRightAdjointSubtypeMemSubgroupIndFunctorSubtype
statement:
@[instance] 
theorem instIsRightAdjointSubtypeMemSubgroupIndFunctorSubtype :
    (indFunctor.{max w u v} k S.subtype).IsRightAdjoint
proof:
:=
  open scoped Classical in (resIndAdjunction k S).isRightAdjoint

name: resIndAdjunction_counit_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma resIndAdjunction_counit_app (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S) :
    (resIndAdjunction.{w, u, v} k S).counit.app A =
      (resFunctor S.subtype).map (indCoindIso.{max w (max u v)} A).hom ≫
      (resCoindAdjunction.{max w u} k S.subtype).counit.app A

name: resIndAdjunction_unit_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma resIndAdjunction_unit_app (B : Rep.{max w u v} k G) :
    (resIndAdjunction.{w, u, v} k S).unit.app B =
      (resCoindAdjunction.{max w u} k S.subtype).unit.app B ≫
      (indCoindIso.{max w (max u v)} (res S.subtype B)).inv

name: resIndAdjunction_homEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma resIndAdjunction_homEquiv_apply (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S)
    {B : Rep.{max w u v} k G} (f : res S.subtype B ⟶ A) :
    (resIndAdjunction.{w, u, v} k S).homEquiv _ _ f =
      resCoindHomEquiv.{max w u v} S.subtype B A f ≫ (indCoindIso.{max w u v} A).inv

name: resIndAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma resIndAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_apply (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S)
    {B : Rep.{max w u v} k G}
    (f : B ⟶ (indFunctor k S.subtype).obj A) :
    ((resIndAdjunction k S).homEquiv _ _).symm f =
      (resCoindHomEquiv.{max w u v} S.subtype B A).symm (f ≫ (indCoindIso.{max w u v} A).hom)

name: instIsLeftAdjointSubtypeMemSubgroupCoindFunctorSubtype
statement:
@[instance] 
theorem instIsLeftAdjointSubtypeMemSubgroupCoindFunctorSubtype :
    (coindFunctor.{max w u v} k S.subtype).IsLeftAdjoint
proof:
:=
  open scoped Classical in (coindResAdjunction k S).isLeftAdjoint

name: coindResAdjunction_counit_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coindResAdjunction_counit_app (B : Rep.{max w u v} k G) :
    (coindResAdjunction.{w, u, v} k S).counit.app B =
      (indCoindIso.{max w u v} (res S.subtype B)).inv ≫
      (indResAdjunction k S.subtype).counit.app B

name: coindResAdjunction_unit_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coindResAdjunction_unit_app (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S) :
    (coindResAdjunction k S).unit.app A = (indResAdjunction k S.subtype).unit.app A ≫
      (resFunctor S.subtype).map (indCoindIso.{max w u v} A).hom

name: coindResAdjunction_homEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma coindResAdjunction_homEquiv_apply (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S)
    {B : Rep k G} (f : coind S.subtype A ⟶ B) :
    (coindResAdjunction k S).homEquiv _ _ f =
      indResHomEquiv S.subtype A B ((indCoindIso.{max w u v} A).hom ≫ f)

name: coindResAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma coindResAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_apply (A : Rep.{max w u v} k S)
    {B : Rep k G} (f : A ⟶ res S.subtype B) :
    ((coindResAdjunction.{max w u v} k S).homEquiv _ _).symm f =
      (indCoindIso.{max w u v} A).inv ≫ (indResHomEquiv S.subtype A B).symm f

name: linearize_single
statement:
lemma linearize_single (g : G) (x : X.V) :
    linearize k G X g (.single x 1) = .single (X.ρ g x) 1

name: linearizeMap_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearizeMap_single (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X.V) (r : k) :
    (linearizeMap f) (.single x r) = .single (f.hom x) r

name: _root_.Action.tensor_
statement:
lemma _root_.Action.tensor_ρ_apply (g : G) (xy : (X ⊗ Y).V) :
    (X ⊗ Y).ρ g xy = (X.ρ g xy.1, Y.ρ g xy.2)

name: coeff_
statement:
lemma coeff_μ_tmul (l1 : k[X.V]) (l2 : k[Y.V]) (xy : (X ⊗ Y).V) :
    (μ X Y (l1 ⊗ₜ l2)).coeff xy = l1.coeff xy.1 * l2.coeff xy.2

name: rTensor_comp_
statement:
lemma rTensor_comp_δ (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((linearizeMap f).rTensor (linearize k G Z)).comp (δ X Z) =
      (δ Y Z).comp (linearizeMap (f ▷ Z))

name: lTensor_comp_
statement:
lemma lTensor_comp_δ (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((linearizeMap f).lTensor (linearize k G Z)).comp (δ Z X) =
      (δ Z Y).comp (linearizeMap (Z ◁ f))

name: assoc_comp_
statement:
lemma assoc_comp_δ : ((assoc (linearize k G X) (linearize k G Y)
    (linearize k G Z)).toIntertwiningMap.comp ((δ X Y).rTensor (linearize k G Z))).comp
    (δ (X ⊗ Y) Z) = (((δ Y Z).lTensor (linearize k G X)).comp (δ X (Y ⊗ Z))).comp

name: mul_average_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_average_left (g : G) : .single g 1 * average k G = average k G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_one, Finset.mul_sum, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, average, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply,
    MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
  set f : G → k[G] := fun x => .single x 1
  change ⅟(Fintype.card G : k) • ∑ x : G, f (g * x) = ⅟(Fintype.card G : k) • ∑ x : G, f x
  rw [Function.Bijective.sum_comp (Group.mulLeft_bijective g) _]

    MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
  set f : G → k[G] := fun x => .single x 1
  change ⅟(Fintype.card G : k) • ∑ x : G, f (x * g) = ⅟(Fintype.card G : k) • ∑ x : G, f x
  rw [Function.Bijective.sum_comp (Group.mulRight_bijective g) _]

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h g, fun hx γ => by
    rcases hg γ with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    induction i with | zero => simp | succ i _ => simp_all [zpow_add_one] | pred i h => _
    simpa [neg_sub_comm _ (1 : ℤ), zpow_sub] using congr(ρ g⁻¹ $(h.trans hx.symm))⟩

proof:

name: mem_invariants_iff_comm

theorem mem_invariants_iff_comm (f : X.V →ₗ[k] Y.V) (g : G) :

proof:
:= by

  · intro h

    rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← Rep.ρ_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one,
      Module.End.one_eq_id, LinearMap.comp_id]
  · intro h
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← h, LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← Rep.ρ_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one,
      Module.End.one_eq_id, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: simple_iff_end_is_rank_one
statement:
lemma simple_iff_end_is_rank_one [NeZero (Nat.card G : k)] (V : FDRep k G) :
    Simple V ↔ Module.finrank k (V ⟶ V) = 1 where
  mp h
proof:
:= finrank_endomorphism_simple_eq_one k V
  mpr h := by
    refine { mono_isIso_iff_nonzero {W} f _ := ⟨fun hf habs ↦ ?_, fun hf ↦ ?_⟩ }
    · rw [habs, isIsoZero_iff_source_target_isZero] at hf
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : V ⟶ V, g ≠ 0 :=
        (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero (R := k)).mp (by grind)
      exact hg (hf.2.eq_zero_of_src g)
    · suffices Epi f by exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi f
      suffices Epi (Abelian.image.ι f) by
        rw [← Abelian.image.fac f]
        exact epi_comp _ _
      rw [← Abelian.image.fac f] at hf
      set ι := Abelian.image.ι f
      set φ := Injective.factorThru (𝟙 _) ι
      have hφι : φ ≫ ι ≠ 0 := by
        intro habs
        have hιφ : 𝟙 _ = ι ≫ φ := (Injective.comp_factorThru (𝟙 _) ι).symm
        apply_fun (· ≫ ι) at hιφ
        simp_all
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : k, c • _ = 𝟙 V := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' _ hφι).mp h (𝟙 V)
      refine Preadditive.epi_of_cancel_zero _ (fun g hg ↦ ?_)
      apply_fun (· ≫ g) at hc
      simpa [hg] using hc.symm

name: simple_iff_char_is_norm_one
statement:
lemma simple_iff_char_is_norm_one [CharZero k] [Fintype G] (V : FDRep k G) :
    Simple V ↔ ∑ g : G, V.character g * V.character g⁻¹ = Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  have := invertibleOfNonzero (NeZero.ne (Nat.card G : k))
  constructor <;> intro h
  · symm; simpa [Nonempty.intro (Iso.refl V), inv_mul_eq_one₀] using char_orthonormal V V
  · have eq := V.scalar_product_char_eq_finrank_equivariant V
    rw [h, inv_mul_cancel_of_invertible] at eq
    rw [simple_iff_end_is_rank_one, ← Nat.cast_inj (R := k), ← eq, Nat.cast_one]

name: isIntegral_character
statement: theorem isIntegral_character [Finite G] (g : G) : IsIntegral ℤ (ρ.character g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (B := AlgebraicClosure k), character, ← trace_baseChange,
    End.trace_eq_sum_roots_charpoly_of_splits (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
  refine IsIntegral.multiset_sum fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly .. |>.2
    (Polynomial.isRoot_of_mem_roots hx) |>.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hxn : x ^ orderOf g = 1 := smul_left_injective (R := AlgebraicClosure k) hv.2 <| by
    simp [← hv.pow_apply, ← baseChange_pow, ← map_pow]
  exact IsIntegral.of_pow (orderOf_pos g) (hxn ▸ isIntegral_one)

name: card_inv_mul_sum_char_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem card_inv_mul_sum_char_eq_finrank :
    (Nat.card G : k)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G, ρ.character g = finrank k (invariants ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (Fintype.card G : k) := by rwa [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  rw [← (isProj_averageMap ρ).trace]
  simp [character, GroupAlgebra.average, _root_.map_sum]

name: card_inv_mul_sum_char_mul_char_eq_finrank

theorem card_inv_mul_sum_char_mul_char_eq_finrank :

      finrank k (IntertwiningMap ρ σ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_comm, ← char_linHom, card_inv_mul_sum_char_eq_finrank,
    (invariantsEquivIntertwiningMap ρ σ).finrank_eq]

name: char_orthonormal
statement:
theorem char_orthonormal [IsIrreducible ρ] [IsIrreducible σ] :
    (Nat.card G : k)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G, ρ.character g * σ.character g⁻¹ =
      if Nonempty (Equiv σ ρ) then ↑1 else ↑0
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Equiv σ ρ)
  · rw [card_inv_mul_sum_char_mul_char_eq_finrank]
    simpa [finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton]
  · obtain φ : σ.Equiv ρ := Classical.choice inferInstance
    rw [char_iso φ, card_inv_mul_sum_char_mul_char_eq_finrank]
    simp

proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => congr; rfl; congr; rfl; intro _; rw [mul_comm, ← FDRep.char_linHom]
  
  rw [FDRep.average_char_eq_finrank_invariants, ← LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    (Representation.linHom.invariantsEquivFDRepHom V W), of_ρ']

name: char_orthonormal
statement:

    (Nat.card G : k)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G, V.character g * W.character g⁻¹ =
      if Nonempty (V ≅ W) then ↑1 else ↑0

name: IsSimpleModule.finrank_eq_one_of_isMulCommutative
statement:
theorem IsSimpleModule.finrank_eq_one_of_isMulCommutative [IsMulCommutative A] :
    Module.finrank k V = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial V := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial A V
  obtain ⟨v, v_nz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : V)
  set U : Submodule A V := { Submodule.span k {v} with
    smul_mem' a w hw := by
      have ⟨t, ht⟩ := (IsSimpleModule.algebraMap_end_bijective_of_isAlgClosed k).2
        (Module.toModuleEnd A V a)
      simpa only [← show _ = a • w from congr($ht w)] using! (k ∙ v).smul_mem t hw }
  obtain hU | hU := eq_bot_or_eq_top U
  · exact (v_nz <| hU.le <| Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v).elim
  · rw [finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero v v_nz]
    rwa [← top_le_iff] at hU ⊢

name: coinvariantsKer_eq_range
statement:
lemma coinvariantsKer_eq_range (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :
    Coinvariants.ker ρ = LinearMap.range (ρ g - LinearMap.id)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro a ⟨⟨γ, α⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.2 (hg γ) with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    induction i with | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩ | succ n _ =>
    use (Fin.partialSum (fun (j : Fin (n + 1)) => ρ (g ^ (j : ℕ)) α) (Fin.last _))
    simpa using ρ.apply_sub_id_partialSum_eq _ _ _
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    simpa using Coinvariants.sub_mem_ker g y

name: coinvariantsKer_leftRegular_eq_ker
statement:
lemma coinvariantsKer_leftRegular_eq_ker :
    Coinvariants.ker (Representation.leftRegular k G) =
      LinearMap.ker ((linearCombination k (fun _ => (1 : k))) ∘ₗ
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) fun x hx => ?_
  · rintro x ⟨⟨g, y⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa [linearCombination, sub_eq_zero, sum_fintype]
      using Finset.sum_bijective _ (Group.mulLeft_bijective g⁻¹) (by simp) (by lia)
  · have : x = x.coeff.sum (fun g r => .single g r - .single 1 r) := by
      ext g
      by_cases hg : g = 1
      · simp_all [linearCombination, sum_apply', MonoidAlgebra.coeff_finsuppSum]
      · simp_all [sum_apply', MonoidAlgebra.coeff_finsuppSum]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.finsuppSum_mem _ _ _ _ fun g _ =>
      Coinvariants.mem_ker_of_eq g (.single 1 (x.coeff g)) _ (by simp)

name: range_norm_eq_ker_applyAsHom_sub
statement:
lemma range_norm_eq_ker_applyAsHom_sub (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :
    LinearMap.range (leftRegular k G).norm.hom.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.ker (applyAsHom (leftRegular k G) g - 𝟙 _).hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (fun _ ⟨_, h⟩ => by simp [sub_hom, applyAsHom_apply _, ← h, norm])
    fun x hx => ⟨.single 1 (x.coeff g), by
    ext γ
    have := coeff_of_leftRegular_of_generator (k := k) g hg x
      (by simpa [sub_hom, sub_eq_zero] using! hx) γ
    simp [norm, Representation.norm, this]⟩

name: range_applyAsHom_sub_eq_ker_linearCombination
statement:
lemma range_applyAsHom_sub_eq_ker_linearCombination (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :

      LinearMap.ker ((linearCombination k (fun _ => (1 : k))) ∘ₗ
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap)
proof:

  simp [sub_hom, applyAsHom, FiniteCyclicGroup.coinvariantsKer_eq_range
    (Representation.leftRegular k G) _ hg,
    ← FiniteCyclicGroup.coinvariantsKer_leftRegular_eq_ker]

name: resolution_quasiIso
statement:
lemma resolution_quasiIso (g : G) (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :
    QuasiIso (resolution.π k g) where
  quasiIsoAt m
proof:
:= by
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      simp only [resolution.π]
      rw [ChainComplex.quasiIsoAt₀_iff, ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros' _ rfl rfl rfl]
      constructor
      · apply (forget₂ _ (ModuleCat k)).reflects_exact_of_faithful
        simpa [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker,
          HomologicalComplex.alternatingConst, ChainComplex.toSingle₀Equiv] using!
          leftRegular.range_applyAsHom_sub_eq_ker_linearCombination k g hg
      · rw [Rep.epi_iff_surjective]
        intro x
        use .single 1 x
        simp [ChainComplex.toSingle₀Equiv]
    | succ m _ =>
      rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt' (hL := ChainComplex.exactAt_succ_single_obj ..),
          HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (m + 2) (m + 1) m (by simp) (by simp)]
      apply (forget₂ _ (ModuleCat k)).reflects_exact_of_faithful
      rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker]
      by_cases hm : Odd (m + 1)
      · simpa [ite_eq_left (Nat.even_add_one.2 (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hm)),
          ite_eq_right (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hm)]
          using! leftRegular.range_norm_eq_ker_applyAsHom_sub k g hg
      · simpa [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker,
          ite_eq_left (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.1 hm),
          ite_eq_right (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 <| Nat.odd_add_one.2 hm)]
          using! leftRegular.range_applyAsHom_sub_eq_ker_norm k g hg

theorem forget₂ToModuleCatHomotopyEquiv_f_0_eq :

    AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε_app_f_zero, compForgetAugmentedIso, eqToIso.inv,
    HomologicalComplex.eqToHom_f, compForgetAugmented, compForgetAugmented.toModule, ε,
    SimplicialObject.augment, Unique.eq_default (terminal.from _), MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,

name: d_single
statement:
lemma d_single (x : Gⁿ⁺¹) :
    (d k G n).hom (single x (.single 1 1)) = single (fun i => x i.succ) (.single (x 0) 1) +
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 1),
        single (j.contractNth (· * ·) x) (.single (1 : G) ((-1 : k) ^ (j.val + 1)))

name: d_comp_diagonalSuccIsoFree_inv_eq
statement:
lemma d_comp_diagonalSuccIsoFree_inv_eq :
    d k G n ≫ (diagonalSuccIsoFree k G n).inv =
      (diagonalSuccIsoFree k G (n + 1)).inv ≫ (standardComplex k G).d (n + 1) n
proof:
:=
  free_ext k G _ _ _ fun i ↦ by
    have eq3 : MonoidAlgebra.single (i 0 • Fin.partialProd fun i_1 ↦ i i_1.succ) (1 : k) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single (Fin.partialProd i ∘ Fin.succ) 1 := by
      congr; exact funext fun j ↦ Fin.partialProd_succ' i j |>.symm
    simp only [Rep.hom_comp, Representation.IntertwiningMap.comp_apply]
    rw [d_single (k := k), map_add, map_sum]
    
    have H : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → G) (g : G) (r : k),
        (diagonalSuccIsoFree k G m).inv.hom (single f (MonoidAlgebra.single g r)) =
          MonoidAlgebra.single (g • Fin.partialProd f) r := by
      intro m f g r
      simp only [diagonalSuccIsoFree, diagonalSuccIsoTensorTrivial, Iso.trans_inv, Rep.hom_comp,
        Representation.IntertwiningMap.comp_apply]
      have step1 : (Hom.hom (leftRegularTensorTrivialIsoFree k G (Fin m → G)).inv)
          (single f (.single g r)) = .single g 1 ⊗ₜ[k] .single f r :=
        Representation.leftRegularTensorTrivialIsoFree_symm_apply_single_single f g r
      rw [step1]
      simp only [mkIso_inv, Representation.linearizeOfMulActionIso, Representation.Equiv.mk_symm,
        LinearEquiv.refl_symm, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, Action.tensorObj_V, Action.trivial_V,
        Functor.mapIso_inv, tensor_V, tensor_ρ, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom, μ_hom,
        MonoidalCategory.tensorIso_inv, Representation.linearizeTrivialIso, hom_tensorHom,
        Representation.IntertwiningMap.tensor_apply, Representation.Equiv.coe_toIntertwiningMap,
        Representation.Equiv.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.refl_apply]
      have key₁ := Representation.linearizeMap_single (k := k)
        (Action.diagonalSuccIsoTensorTrivial G m).inv (g, f) ((1 : k) * r)
      have key₂ := Representation.LinearizeMonoidal.μ_apply_single_single (k := k)
        (X := Action.leftRegular G) (Y := Action.trivial G (Fin m → G)) g f 1 r
      exact ((congrArg (fun z => (Representation.linearizeMap
        (Action.diagonalSuccIsoTensorTrivial G m).inv) z) key₂).trans key₁).trans (by simp)
    simp only [H, one_smul]
    simp [d_apply (k := k), Fin.partialProd_contractNth, Fin.sum_univ_succ, eq3]

proof:

      epi_iff_surjective] at h₂ h₃

  · rintro @⟨_, mono_f, epi_g⟩
    exact {
      exact := by rwa [ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful]
      mono_f := by simpa [mono_iff_injective] using! mono_f

lemma sum_hom {ι : Type u'} (f : ι → (A ⟶ B)) (s : Finset ι) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i).hom = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha h => simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, add_hom, h]

name: ofHom_sum

    (s : Finset ι) :
    ofHom (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ofHom (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha h => simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, ofHom_add, h]

name: to_Module_monoidAlgebra_map_aux
statement:
theorem to_Module_monoidAlgebra_map_aux {k G : Type*} [CommRing k] [Monoid G] (V W : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k V] [Module k W] (ρ : G →* V →ₗ[k] V)
    (σ : G →* W →ₗ[k] W) (f : V →ₗ[k] W) (w : ∀ g : G, f.comp (ρ g) = (σ g).comp f)
    (r : k[G]) (x : V) :
    f (MonoidAlgebra.lift k (V →ₗ[k] V) G ρ r x) =
      MonoidAlgebra.lift k (W →ₗ[k] W) G σ r (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidAlgebra.induction_on r
  · intro g
    simp only [one_smul, MonoidAlgebra.lift_single, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (w g) x
  · intro g h gw hw; simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hw, gw]
  · intro r g w
    simp only [map_smul, w, LinearMap.smul_apply]

lemma map_chainsFunctor_shortExact :
    ShortExact (X.map (chainsFunctor k G))
proof:
:=
  letI := hX.mono_f
  HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact _ fun i => {
    exact := by
      have : LinearMap.range X.f.hom.toLinearMap = LinearMap.ker X.g.hom.toLinearMap :=
        (hX.exact.map (forget₂ (Rep k G) (ModuleCat k))).moduleCat_range_eq_ker
      simp [moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker, ker_mapRange,
        range_mapRange_linearMap X.f.hom.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 <|
        (Rep.mono_iff_injective X.f).1 hX.mono_f), this]
    mono_f := chainsMap_id_f_map_mono X.f i
    epi_g := letI := hX.epi_g; chainsMap_id_f_map_epi X.g i }

      (shortComplexH1 _).pOpcycles).hom (LinearMap.range ((mapShortComplexH1 S.subtype (𝟙 _)).τ₂ ≫
      (shortComplexH1 _).pOpcycles).hom) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  rcases mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) (chains₁ToCoinvariantsKer_surjective
    (res S.subtype A)) x with ⟨(X : G →₀ S →₀ A), hX⟩
  let Y : S →₀ A := X.sum fun g f =>
    mapRange.linearMap (A.ρ g⁻¹) (lmapDomain _ k (fun s => MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ s) f) - f

  use Y
  apply (moduleCat_pOpcycles_eq_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨Z, ?_⟩
  change d₂₁ A Z = mapRange id rfl (lmapDomain _ k Subtype.val Y) -
    mapRange.linearMap (Submodule.subtype _) (mapDomain id x)
  simp only [mapDomain]
  simpa [map_finsuppSum, mapDomain, map_sub, ← hX, sum_single_index, curryLinearEquiv,
    curryEquiv, Finsupp.uncurry, d₂₁, Y, Z, sum_mapRange_index,

name: H1InfRes_exact
statement: lemma H1InfRes_exact : (H1InfRes A S).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleCat_exact_iff_ker_sub_range]
  intro x hx
  induction x using H1_induction_on with | @h x =>
  simp_all only [HInfRes_X₂, HInfRes_X₃, HInfRes_g, HInfRes_X₁, LinearMap.mem_ker,
    H1π_comp_map_apply S.subtype, HInfRes_f]
  rcases (H1π_eq_zero_iff _).1 hx with ⟨(y : A), hy⟩
  have h1 := (mem_cocycles₁_iff x).1 x.2
  have h2 : ∀ s ∈ S, x s = A.ρ s y - y :=
    fun s hs => funext_iff.1 hy.symm ⟨s, hs⟩
  refine ⟨H1π _ ⟨fun g => Quotient.liftOn' g (fun g => ⟨x.1 g - A.ρ g y + y, ?_⟩) ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s
    calc
      _ = x (s * g) - x s - A.ρ s (A.ρ g y) + (x s + y) := by
        simp [add_eq_of_eq_sub (h2 s s.2), sub_eq_of_eq_add (h1 s g)]
      _ = x (g * (g⁻¹ * s * g)) - A.ρ g (A.ρ (g⁻¹ * s * g) y - y) - A.ρ g y + y := by
        simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, map_sub,
          Representation.self_inv_apply]
        abel
      _ = x g - A.ρ g y + y := by
        simp [eq_sub_of_add_eq' (h1 g (g⁻¹ * s * g)).symm,
          h2 (g⁻¹ * s * g) (Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem' ‹_› _ s.2 _)]
  · intro g h hgh
    have := congr(A.ρ g $(h2 (g⁻¹ * h) <| QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.1 hgh))
    simp_all [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub]
  · rw [mem_cocycles₁_iff]
    intro g h
    induction g using QuotientGroup.induction_on with | @H g =>
    induction h using QuotientGroup.induction_on with | @H h =>
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [← QuotientGroup.mk_mul, h1 g h, sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_assoc]
  · symm
    simp only [H1π_comp_map_apply, H1π_eq_iff (A := A)]
    use y
    ext g
    simp [coe_mapCocycles₁ (QuotientGroup.mk' S),
      cocycles₁.coe_mk (A := A.quotientToInvariants S), ← sub_sub]

      (toAdditive.symm <| ofMul x))).1 = algebraMap K L (Algebra.norm K (x : L))

name: exists_div_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_div_of_norm_eq_one (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) {x : L}
    (hx : Algebra.norm K x = 1) : ∃ y : Lˣ, y / g y = x
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ x, Algebra.norm K x = 1 → ∃ y : Lˣ, g y / y = x by
    have hxinv : Algebra.norm K x⁻¹ = 1 := by simp [Algebra.norm_inv, hx]
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H _ hxinv
    use y
    rw [IsUnit.div_eq_iff y.isUnit] at hy
    rw [hy]
    field_simp
  intro x hx
  let xu : Lˣ := (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff.1 <| hx ▸ zero_ne_one.symm).isUnit.unit
  have hx' : algebraMap K L (Algebra.norm K (xu : L)) = _ := congrArg (algebraMap K L) hx
  rw [← norm_ofAlgebraAutOnUnits_eq xu, map_one] at hx'
  have := FiniteCyclicGroup.groupCohomologyπOdd_eq_zero_iff (ofAlgebraAutOnUnits K L) g hg
    1 (by simp) ⟨toAdditive.symm <| ofMul xu, by simp_all⟩
  rcases this.1 (Subsingleton.elim (α := groupCohomology.H1 (Rep.ofAlgebraAutOnUnits K L)) _ _)
    with ⟨y, hy⟩
  use toMul <| toAdditive y
  have := Units.ext_iff.1 congr(toMul <| toAdditive $hy)
  simp only [sub_hom, hom_id,
    Representation.IntertwiningMap.sub_toLinearMap, Representation.IntertwiningMap.toLinearMap_id,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, Representation.IntertwiningMap.coe_toLinearMap, applyAsHom_apply,
    LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq,
    toAdditive_symm_apply, toAdditive_apply, toMul_ofMul, IsUnit.unit_spec, xu] at this
  rw [← this, toMul_sub]
  simp

name: exists_mul_galRestrict_of_norm_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree A L := by
    rw [Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K L]
    exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective A K)
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B A⁰) L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isLocalization A K L B
  let η' : Lˣ := Units.mk0 (algebraMap B L η) (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hη)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ := exists_div_of_norm_eq_one hg hη
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B A⁰) ε.1
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := b.prop
  have : t • IsLocalization.mk' L a b = algebraMap _ _ a := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L, ht', IsLocalization.mk'_spec']
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl
    simp only [IsLocalization.mk'_zero, _root_.map_zero, div_zero, ← h] at hε
    rw [← hε, Algebra.norm_zero] at hη
    exact zero_ne_one hη
  · replace hε := hε.symm
    rw [← h, eq_div_iff_mul_eq] at hε
    · replace hε := congr_arg (t • ·) hε
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_left_comm, ← Algebra.smul_def t, ← g.toAlgHom_apply,
        ← AlgHom.map_smul_of_tower, this] at hε
      apply IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_injective B A L
      rw [map_mul, ← hε]
      congr 1
      exact algebraMap_galRestrictHom_apply A K L B g a
    · intro e
      rw [(map_eq_zero _).mp e, zero_div] at hε
      rw [hε, Algebra.norm_zero] at hη
      exact zero_ne_one hη

    toCocycles A 1 2 ≫ (isoCocycles₂ A).hom =
      (cochainsIso₁ A).hom ≫ (shortComplexH2 A).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.f'
proof:
:= by
  simp [← cancel_mono (shortComplexH2 A).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i, comp_d₁₂_eq,
    shortComplexH2_f]

name: cocyclesMk
statement:
lemma cocyclesMk₂_eq (x : cocycles₂ A) :
    cocyclesMk ((cochainsIso₂ A).inv x) (by
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← ModuleCat.hom_comp, ← inhomogeneousCochains.d_def,
        eq_d₂₃_comp_inv, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, cocycles₂.d₂₃_apply x,
        map_zero]) = (isoCocycles₂ A).inv x
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun (forget₂ _ Ab).map ((inhomogeneousCochains A).iCycles 2) using
    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 <| (forget₂ _ _).map_mono _
  rw [HomologicalComplex.i_cyclesMk]
  simp; rfl

name: H0_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem H0_induction_on {C : H0 A → Prop} (x : H0 A)
    (h : ∀ x : A.ρ.invariants, C ((H0Iso A).inv x)) : C x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using h ((H0Iso A).hom x)

name: H0IsoOfIsTrivial_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem H0IsoOfIsTrivial_hom :
    (H0IsoOfIsTrivial A).hom = (H0Iso A).hom ≫ (shortComplexH0 A).f

name: H0IsoOfIsTrivial_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem H0IsoOfIsTrivial_inv_apply (x : A) :
    (H0IsoOfIsTrivial A).inv x = (H0Iso A).inv ⟨x, by simp [isTrivial_apply]⟩

name: H1
statement: lemma H1π_eq_zero_iff (x : cocycles₁ A) : H1π A x = 0 ↔ ⇑x ∈ coboundaries₁ A
proof:
:= by
  have h := leftHomologyπ_naturality'_assoc (isoShortComplexH1 A).inv
    (shortComplexH1 A).moduleCatLeftHomologyData (leftHomologyData _)
    ((inhomogeneousCochains A).sc 1).leftHomologyIso.hom
  simp only [H1π, isoCocycles₁, π, HomologicalComplex.homologyπ, homologyπ,
    cyclesMapIso'_inv, leftHomologyπ, ← h, ← leftHomologyMapIso'_inv, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
    LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_eq_zero_iff _
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective <| _).1 inferInstance)]
  simp [LinearMap.range_codRestrict, coboundaries₁, shortComplexH1, cocycles₁]

name: H1
statement:
lemma H1π_eq_iff (x y : cocycles₁ A) :
    H1π A x = H1π A y ↔ ⇑x - ⇑y ∈ coboundaries₁ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, H1π_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

name: H1_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem H1_induction_on {C : H1 A → Prop} (x : H1 A) (h : ∀ x : cocycles₁ A, C (H1π A x)) :
    C x
proof:
:=
  groupCohomology_induction_on x fun y => by simpa [H1π] using h ((isoCocycles₁ A).hom y)

name: H1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp), elementwise (attr := simp)]
theorem H1π_comp_H1IsoOfIsTrivial_hom :
    H1π A ≫ (H1IsoOfIsTrivial A).hom = (cocycles₁IsoOfIsTrivial A).hom

name: H1IsoOfIsTrivial_H1
statement:
theorem H1IsoOfIsTrivial_H1π_apply_apply
    (f : cocycles₁ A) (x : Additive G) :
    (H1IsoOfIsTrivial A).hom (H1π A f) x = f x.toMul

name: H1IsoOfIsTrivial_inv_apply
statement:
theorem H1IsoOfIsTrivial_inv_apply (f : Additive G →+ A) :
    (H1IsoOfIsTrivial A).inv f = H1π A ((cocycles₁IsoOfIsTrivial A).inv f)

name: H2
statement: lemma H2π_eq_zero_iff (x : cocycles₂ A) : H2π A x = 0 ↔ ⇑x ∈ coboundaries₂ A
proof:
:= by
  have h := leftHomologyπ_naturality'_assoc (isoShortComplexH2 A).inv
    (shortComplexH2 A).moduleCatLeftHomologyData (leftHomologyData _)
    ((inhomogeneousCochains A).sc 2).leftHomologyIso.hom
  simp only [H2π, isoCocycles₂, π, HomologicalComplex.homologyπ, homologyπ,
    cyclesMapIso'_inv, leftHomologyπ, ← h, ← leftHomologyMapIso'_inv, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
    LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_eq_zero_iff _
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective <| _).1 inferInstance)]
  simp [LinearMap.range_codRestrict, coboundaries₂, shortComplexH2, cocycles₂]

name: H2
statement:
lemma H2π_eq_iff (x y : cocycles₂ A) :
    H2π A x = H2π A y ↔ ⇑x - ⇑y ∈ coboundaries₂ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, H2π_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

name: H2_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem H2_induction_on {C : H2 A → Prop} (x : H2 A) (h : ∀ x : cocycles₂ A, C (H2π A x)) :
    C x
proof:
:=
  groupCohomology_induction_on x fun y => by simpa [H2π] using h ((isoCocycles₂ A).hom y)

name: Rep.tateNorm_eq
statement:
lemma Rep.tateNorm_eq :
    M.tateNorm = ModuleCat.ofHom (Finsupp.lsum R fun _ ↦ LinearMap.pi fun _ ↦ M.ρ.norm)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_all [tateNorm, chainsIso₀, cochainsIso₀, Unique.eq_default]

name: Rep.norm_comp_d_eq_zero
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp), elementwise]
lemma Rep.norm_comp_d_eq_zero : M.norm.toModuleCatHom ≫ d₀₁ M = 0

name: Rep.tateNorm_comp_d
statement: lemma Rep.tateNorm_comp_d : tateNorm M ≫ (inhomogeneousCochains M).d 0 1 = 0

name: Rep.comp_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Rep.comp_eq_zero : d₁₀ M ≫ M.norm.toModuleCatHom = 0

name: Rep.d_comp_tateNorm
statement: lemma Rep.d_comp_tateNorm : (inhomogeneousChains M).d 1 0 ≫ M.tateNorm = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tateNorm, ← Category.assoc, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero]
  simp [← comp_d₁₀_eq _]

name: tateComplex_d_neg_one
statement: lemma tateComplex_d_neg_one : (tateComplex M).d (-1) 0 = M.tateNorm

name: tateComplex_d_ofNat
statement:
lemma tateComplex_d_ofNat (n : ℕ) :
    (tateComplex M).d n (n + 1) = (inhomogeneousCochains M).d n (n + 1)

name: tateComplex_d_neg
statement:
lemma tateComplex_d_neg (n : ℕ) :
    (tateComplex M).d (-(n + 2 : ℤ)) (-(n + 1 : ℤ)) = (inhomogeneousChains M).d (n + 1) n

name: tateComplex.map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tateComplex.map_zero : tateComplex.map (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0

name: tateComplex.map_add
statement:
lemma tateComplex.map_add (f g : X ⟶ Y) : tateComplex.map (f + g) =
    tateComplex.map f + tateComplex.map g
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) : 1
  · rfl
  · ext1
    simp only [CochainComplex.ConnectData.map_f, chainsMap_id_f_hom_eq_mapRange, Rep.add_hom,
      Representation.IntertwiningMap.add_toLinearMap, HomologicalComplex.add_f_apply,
      ModuleCat.hom_add]
    ext; simp

name: map_tateComplexFunctor_shortExact
statement:
lemma map_tateComplexFunctor_shortExact {S : ShortComplex (Rep R G)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (tateComplexFunctor R G)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact , ← ShortComplex.map_comp]
  rintro (_ | _)
  · exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (ShortComplex.mapNatIso _ (tateComplex.evalNonneg _).symm)
      <| map_cochainsFunctor_eval_shortExact hS _
  · exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (ShortComplex.mapNatIso _ (tateComplex.evalNeg _).symm)
      <| map_chainsFunctor_eval_shortExact hS _

name: map_
statement:
lemma map_δ {S : ShortComplex (Rep R G)} (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    (tateCohomologyFunctor n).map S.g ≫ δ hS n = 0

name: exact
statement:
lemma exact₃ {S : ShortComplex (Rep R G)} (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (map_δ hS n)).Exact

name: exact
statement:
lemma exact₁ {S : ShortComplex (Rep R G)} (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (δ_map hS n)).Exact

name: resolutionMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma resolutionMap_zero (φ : H →ₜ* G) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) :
    resolutionMap φ f 0 = f

name: resolutionMap_succ
statement:
lemma resolutionMap_succ (φ : H →ₜ* G) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (i : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap φ f (i + 1) = ofHom (coind₁ResMap φ (resolutionMap φ f i).hom)

name: resolutionMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma resolutionMap_id (X : TopRep k G) (i : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) (𝟙 X) i = 𝟙 (resolutionX X i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [resolutionMap_succ, ih]
    ext F x
    rfl

name: resolutionMap_comp
statement:
lemma resolutionMap_comp (φ : H →ₜ* G) (ψ : K →ₜ* H) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (g : res ψ Y ⟶ Z)
    (i : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap (φ.comp ψ) (X := X) ((resFunctor (ψ : K →* H)).map f ≫ g) i =
      (resFunctor (ψ : K →* H)).map (resolutionMap φ f i) ≫ resolutionMap ψ g i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [resolutionMap_succ, resolutionMap_succ, resolutionMap_succ, ih]
    ext F x
    rfl

name: resolutionMap_comp_d
statement:
lemma resolutionMap_comp_d (φ : H →ₜ* G) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (i : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap φ f i ≫ d Y i =
      (resFunctor (φ : H →* G)).map (d X i) ≫ resolutionMap φ f (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    ext : 1
    replace ih := congr($(ih).hom)
    simp only [TopRep.hom_comp, resolutionMap_succ, TopRep.hom_ofHom, hom_d_succ,
      ContIntertwiningMap.restrict_sub, ContIntertwiningMap.sub_comp,
      ContIntertwiningMap.comp_sub, coind₁Map_comp_coind₁ResMap,
      coind₁ResMap_comp_coind₁Map_restrict] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih, ← coind₁ResMap_comp_coind₁ι_restrict]

name: cochainsMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cochainsMap_id (X : TopRep k G) :
    cochainsMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 (homogeneousCochains X)
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  rw [cochainsMap_f, resolutionMap_id]
  ext v
  rfl

name: cochainsMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma cochainsMap_comp (φ : H →ₜ* G) (ψ : K →ₜ* H) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (g : res ψ Y ⟶ Z) :
    cochainsMap (φ.comp ψ) (X := X) ((resFunctor (ψ : K →* H)).map f ≫ g) =
      cochainsMap φ f ≫ cochainsMap ψ g
proof:
:= by
  ext i v x
  exact congr($(resolutionMap_comp φ ψ f g (i + 1)).hom v.1 x)

name: cocyclesMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cocyclesMap_id (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) :
    cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) (𝟙 X) n = 𝟙 _

name: cocyclesMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma cocyclesMap_comp (φ : H →ₜ* G) (ψ : K →ₜ* H) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (g : res ψ Y ⟶ Z)
    (n : ℕ) :
    cocyclesMap (φ.comp ψ) (X := X) ((resFunctor (ψ : K →* H)).map f ≫ g) n =
      cocyclesMap φ f n ≫ cocyclesMap ψ g n

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_id (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) :
    map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) (𝟙 X) n = 𝟙 _

name: map_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_comp (φ : H →ₜ* G) (ψ : K →ₜ* H) (f : res φ X ⟶ Y) (g : res ψ Y ⟶ Z) (n : ℕ) :
    map (φ.comp ψ) (X := X) ((resFunctor (ψ : K →* H)).map f ≫ g) n = map φ f n ≫ map ψ g n

name: d_zero
statement: lemma d_zero (X : TopRep k G) : d X 0 = ofHom X.ρ.coind₁ι

name: d_succ
statement:
lemma d_succ (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) :
    d X (n + 1) = ofHom (resolutionX X (n + 1)).ρ.coind₁ι - (coind₁Functor k G).map (d X n)

name: hom_d_succ
statement:
lemma hom_d_succ (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) :
    (d X (n + 1)).hom = (resolutionX X (n + 1)).ρ.coind₁ι -
      ContRepresentation.coind₁Map (d X n).hom

name: d_comp_d
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma d_comp_d (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) : d X n ≫ d X (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    ext
    simp [d_succ, ContIntertwiningMap.toContinuousLinearMap_apply, d_zero, hom_sub]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [d_succ _ (n + 1), Preadditive.comp_sub]
    nth_rw 2 [d_succ]
    rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ih, Functor.map_zero, sub_zero, sub_eq_zero]
    rfl

name: resolution'd_eq
statement:
lemma resolution'd_eq (X : TopRep k G) (n : ℕ) :
    resolution'd X n = d X (n + 1)

name: homogeneousCochains.d_eq
statement:
lemma homogeneousCochains.d_eq (X : TopRep k G) (i : ℕ) :
    (homogeneousCochains X).d i (i + 1) =
      (invariantsFunctor k G).map (d X (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← resolution'd_eq, CochainComplex.of_d]

name: homogeneousCochains.d_apply
statement:
lemma homogeneousCochains.d_apply (X : TopRep k G) (i : ℕ)
    (σ : (homogeneousCochains X).X i) :
    ((homogeneousCochains X).d i (i + 1)).hom σ = (d X (i + 1)).hom σ

name: cocycles
statement:
lemma cocycles₀IsoAux (σ : (homogeneousCochains X).X 0)
    (hσ : σ ∈ ((homogeneousCochains X).d 0 1).hom.ker) : σ.1 1 ∈ X.ρ.invariants
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, LinearMap.mem_ker, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
    Subtype.ext_iff, homogeneousCochains.d_apply _] at hσ
  simp only [mem_invariants]
  intro g
  rw [d_succ, hom_sub, hom_ofHom, ContIntertwiningMap.sub_apply, d_zero,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hσ
  replace hσ := DFunLike.ext_iff.1 (DFunLike.ext_iff.1 hσ 1) g⁻¹
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, coind₁ι_toFun, ContinuousMap.const_apply, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom,
    coind₁Map_toFun, ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk] at hσ
  simpa [hσ] using DFunLike.ext_iff.1 (σ.2 g) 1

name: mem_const_resol
statement:
lemma mem_const_resol₀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ X.ρ.invariants) :
    ContinuousMap.const G x ∈ ((resolution' X).X 0).ρ.invariants

name: cocycles
statement:
lemma cocycles₀IsoAux' (x : X) (h : ContinuousMap.const G x ∈ ((resolution' X).X 0).ρ.invariants) :
    ⟨ContinuousMap.const G x, h⟩ ∈ ((homogeneousCochains X).d 0 1).hom.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Subtype.ext_iff, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
    homogeneousCochains.d_apply]
  simp [d_succ, hom_sub, ContIntertwiningMap.sub_apply, d_zero]
